bug_semantics: When the image proxy is enabled, an authenticated forum user can embed an attacker-selected non-HTTPS URL in an IMG BBCode tag. SMF rewrites it to its own proxy.php URL and supplies the secret-derived hash, after which the server dereferences the selected URL. Before the fixes, that dereference did not reliably reject hostnames resolving to loopback, private, link-local, cloud-metadata, or other reserved addresses, and redirects could reach the same destinations. The hash therefore did not prevent an authenticated poster from causing SSRF into services visible to the SMF host.
flaw_origin: The vulnerable operation is the image proxy's server-side dereference of a signed, user-selected URL without resolved-destination safety validation. Commit dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847 first wrote that operation when it added proxy.php and passed $request directly to curl_fetch_web_data::get_url_data(). Commit a892a53ba45330d69b8ad8b1ede82aebaa29537b later automated proxy URL and hash generation for untrusted IMG BBCode and thereby completed the advisory's authenticated posting path, but it did not first write the unsafe fetch. Under the protocol's smallest-first-vulnerable-lines rule, dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847 is the BIC and a892a53ba45330d69b8ad8b1ede82aebaa29537b is a later reachability/enabling commit.
ai_marker: absent: git cat-file commit dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847 names Shitiz Garg <mail@dragooon.net> as both author and committer and contains only Signed-off-by: Shitiz Garg <mail@dragooon.net>; there is no AI Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI marker in the BIC commit object.
evidence: Introducer disagreement resolved in favor of the reviewer: the primary chose a892a53ba45330d69b8ad8b1ede82aebaa29537b, while the reviewer chose dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847. git log --all --reverse -S'$curl->get_url_data($request)' -- proxy.php Sources/ProxyServer.php returns dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847 first, and git log -L 98,100:proxy.php dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847 attributes creation of the curl object, get_url_data($request), and result() lines to that same new-file commit. The later f656bc2f1336580eebeb243b4294e6491ade5d56 entry removes/replaces the implementation and is not an origin.

git show eb7314fc8e763023a2f02790669e1d224a6a74d6..dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847 -- proxy.php shows proxy.php added from /dev/null and cacheImage() fetching the signed request with no hostname resolution or private/reserved-address rejection. This is a granular feature commit, not a move, import, revert, merge, or squash aggregate.

Parent disagreement resolved in favor of the reviewer: git rev-parse dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847^ returns eb7314fc8e763023a2f02790669e1d224a6a74d6, and git ls-tree -r --name-only eb7314fc8e763023a2f02790669e1d224a6a74d6 -- proxy.php returns no entry. The unsafe image-proxy endpoint and fetch are therefore absent in the BIC's immediate parent. The primary's 5c923a26d6c55060efdaf4d489403b06de8f65a1 is only the immediate parent of the later signer commit a892a53ba45330d69b8ad8b1ede82aebaa29537b and already contains proxy.php and its unsafe fetch.

The primary's a892a53ba45330d69b8ad8b1ede82aebaa29537b remains causally important but is not the first flawed-line commit: git log --all --reverse -S'/proxy.php?request=' -- Sources/Subs.php identifies it as the initial IMG-BBCode automatic-signing change, while the unsafe get_url_data($request) line is already traced to dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847. Later extraction in 72b01034c2773bff3a6b9be6b859acce1b79f19f and the later SMF\Url rewrite are refactors, not BICs.

Version-boundary checks place the BIC on both affected lines: git merge-base --is-ancestor dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847 v2.1.0 and the same check against v3.0-alpha.1 both exit zero. The last vulnerable tags present also precede the corresponding fixes: v2.1.7 is an ancestor of b4d23dfd74a511587c605f9d294cefc3a75b4b26, and v3.0-alpha.4 is an ancestor of 4bf35cf9e45573a5f55a6f52995086c1da89c096. Neither advisory fix merge is contained in a tag in the frozen clone, so the closing boundary is commit-based.

The assigned advisory names both closing commits. The fix_sha topic is confirmed at 4bf35cf9e45573a5f55a6f52995086c1da89c096: both prior outputs named it, git cat-file shows first parent 57d30d5a0ec32073d0dd1fe5b038d41dd84171b3 and second parent ce59add4bdcacea557fb9a9763ad4b24d75a8a48, git branch -a --contains places it on release-3.0, and git diff --quiet ce59add4bdcacea557fb9a9763ad4b24d75a8a48 4bf35cf9e45573a5f55a6f52995086c1da89c096 exits zero. The parallel 2.1 close is b4d23dfd74a511587c605f9d294cefc3a75b4b26 on release-2.1 with direct second parent 10a998ccbae25bd95d4c3857a66a30b018bb5fda.

The 3.0 fix branch runs from 6d8b5f2d5ddf14b26bf6e9e0812db9327770902d through ce59add4bdcacea557fb9a9763ad4b24d75a8a48. The first member adds WebFetchApi::isFetchSafe() and rejects unresolved, loopback, private, link-local, and reserved initial targets; the series then tightens scheme, reserved-domain, object, proxy, and IPv6 handling. Because ce59add4bdcacea557fb9a9763ad4b24d75a8a48 is the merge's direct second-parent tip and its tree equals the merge tree, it is recorded as direct_fix_sha rather than the first intermediate member.

AI attribution uses only the resolved BIC object. git cat-file commit dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847 shows a single parent, human author and committer Shitiz Garg, subject 'Implement an Image Proxy', and only a human Signed-off-by trailer. The Claude Co-Authored-By trailer on later fix member 6d8b5f2d5ddf14b26bf6e9e0812db9327770902d is fix-only evidence and is excluded by the protocol.
reasoning: The audits disagreed because they selected different points in the feature lifecycle. The primary selected the later commit that makes an authenticated BBCode author's URL automatically signed, whereas the reviewer selected the earlier commit that first writes the security-sensitive dereference without destination validation. The protocol defines the BIC as the smallest commit that first wrote the vulnerable lines, so line history, pickaxe history, and the direct-parent tree make the reviewer's dcbaefb0976cf3e9d9490455bb59504d5c807847 / eb7314fc8e763023a2f02790669e1d224a6a74d6 pair controlling; the primary pair identifies a later enabling step, not origin. The BIC is granular and its parent lacks proxy.php, so no squash decomposition is needed. For the fix topic, the advisory merge 4bf35cf9e45573a5f55a6f52995086c1da89c096 is verified on release-3.0, its direct second-parent tip has the same final tree, and the parallel release-2.1 merge is separately verified. The BIC commit object has no AI signal, yielding a gate-complete NOT_AI verdict.
